mandate: Step 185: FastMCP Closed-Loop Precision Temperature PID Controller Simulation Audit

invariant_01_normal_equilibrium.description: Normal equilibrium at Setpoint = 150.0, zero error, null split-range effort

invariant_02_positive_error_heat_demand.description: Positive error heat demand: PV below SP produces modulating heat output

invariant_03_negative_error_cool_demand.description: Negative error cool demand: PV above SP produces modulating cool output

invariant_04_deadband_filtering.description: Deadband filtering: Error within +/- 0.5 suppressed to prevent actuator hunting

invariant_05_alpha_low_pass_filtering.description: Alpha low-pass filtering: First-order filter smooths raw analog noise

invariant_06_bumpless_transfer.description: Bumpless transfer: IntegralSum preloaded to manual effort prevents step disruption on mode switch

invariant_07_pwm_ssr_pulse.description: Time-proportional PWM SSR pulse generation: 40% duty cycle matches 20/50 scans

invariant_08_alarm_hh.description: AlarmHH critical trip: High-high temperature triggers latched shutdown

invariant_09_alarm_ll.description: AlarmLL critical trip: Low-low temperature triggers latched trip

invariant_10_alarm_hl.description: AlarmH/L: Unlatched high and low warning annunciations track process limits

invariant_11_sensor_fault.description: SensorFault: Open RTD/thermocouple fault immediately locks out heating and cooling

invariant_12_reset_alarm.description: ResetAlarm: Acknowledges and clears latched alarms once process normalizes

invariant_13_fastmcp_partitioned_registe.description: FastMCP multi-client partitioned registers %R125 vs %R135 isolation and zero cross-talk

invariant_14_download_lockout.description: Fail-closed download lockout for commands 32827 and 33149
